# HTMXUI — Hyper Reactive Lean Framework for AI & Humans

> HTMXUI is a hyperreactive, hypermedia-first framework with fine-grained signals, in-memory fuzzy search, declarative validation, and FLIP animations — with zero Virtual DOM.

## Core Rules for AI Coders
1. NEVER generate React/JSX/Vue code when asked for HTMXUI. Always output declarative HTML with `hx-*` attributes.
2. State Declaration: Prefer `<script type="application/json" hx-state> { "key": "value" } </script>` inside the component root over `hx-state='{...}'` to avoid quote escaping bugs.
3. Two-Way Binding: Use `hx-model="prop"` for inputs, checkboxes, radios, selects. Modifiers: `.number`, `.lazy`, `.trim`.
4. Loops: Use `<template hx-for="item in items">` or `<template hx-for="(item, idx) in items">`.
5. Conditionals: Use `<template hx-if="condition">` for structural insertion/removal, or `hx-show="condition"` for display toggle.
6. Computed State: Use `hx-computed='{ fullName: first + " " + last }'` on the root element.
7. Actions: Use `hx-on:click.prevent="count++"` or `@click.prevent="count++"`.
8. Global Stores: Access via `$store.storeName.property`.
9. Form Validation: Use `hx-validate="required|email|min:3"`.

## Core Engines
- `htmx-bolt.js`: Signal-based reactive state engine (~8KB).
- `htmx-flash.js`: In-memory typo-tolerant fuzzy search and multi-column filter engine (~3KB).
- `htmx-form.js`: Declarative validation state machine & optimistic UI engine (~2KB).
- `htmx-vibe.js`: Kinetic motion, spring physics (`hx-vibe-spring`), 3D tilt (`hx-vibe-tilt`), magnetic pull (`hx-vibe-magnetic`), split-text (`hx-vibe-split`), and blast shockwaves (`hx-vpx-blast`).
- `htmx-a11y.js`: WAI-ARIA focus trap & roving tabindex engine (~2KB).
- `HxBolt.ticker`: High-frequency 120 FPS game-loop ticker (`hx-tick="x += 0.01 * dt"`).
- `HTMXUI.directive(name, handler)`: Custom declarative directive compiler for community 3D/game engines.

## Rosetta Stone (React → HTMXUI)
- `useState({ count: 0 })` -> `<script type="application/json" hx-state>{"count": 0}</script>`
- `useMemo(() => price * qty, [price, qty])` -> `hx-computed="{ total: price * qty }"`
- `useEffect(() => { ... }, [count])` -> `hx-effect="console.log(count)"`
- `useContext(AuthContext)` -> `$store.auth.user`
- `items.map(item => <Item key={item.id} />)` -> `<template hx-for="item in items">`
- `value={val} onChange={e => setVal(e.target.value)}` -> `hx-model="val"`
- `<Modal isOpen={open} />` -> `<div hx-show="open" hx-trap-focus>`
- `<motion.div whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }} />` -> `<div hx-vibe-tilt="15" hx-vlt-glare>`

## Full API Specification
See `https://htmxui.dev/schema/htmxui.json` and `/llms-full.txt`
